title: Clues About Sister
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji stepped into the imperial city, the chessboard of fate quietly began to turn—and what he did not know was that a pair of eyes long watching him were revealing a meaningful smile in the shadows.

text.content:
The imperial procession wound like a dragon through the streets, golden banners rustling in the morning wind. Chen Ji stood among the crowd, his expression as calm as still water, only those deep eyes suddenly contracting at one moment—the figure, that familiar silhouette, was faintly visible beneath the bright yellow canopy.

His breath stopped for an instant.

Those eyebrows and eyes, that posture, were unmistakably his long-missing sister Chen Nian.

But why was she appearing in the imperial envoy's ranks? Coerced, or imprisoned? Countless questions surged like a tide, but Chen Ji forcibly suppressed them, his face still maintaining that unmoved expression of a useless person.

dialogue.content: (His heart shaking internally, yet smiling more gently) Sister... what exactly have you experienced in the imperial city?

text.content:
The imperial envoy finished reading the cooperation conditions, and the crowd议论纷纷. Yet Chen Ji remained oblivious, all his mental focus locked onto that familiar figure. She was sandwiched between two elders with profound auras, her steps mechanical, her gaze vacant, like a soulless husk.

Chen's heart clenched painfully.

That wasn't the state of a living person—it was the sign of having been extracted from the spirit and soul!

Without hesitation, he activated the Tianji Record in front of the crowd. The characters on the fragment glowed faintly, an intangible force probing toward Chen Nian's direction. However, the moment it touched her, a strange fluctuation rebounded the probing force.

A blurry line of text appeared on the Tianji Record, seemingly deliberately obscured by some power, yet still retaining traces of discernible aura—

「Dragon vein... forbidden grounds... sacrifice...」

dialogue.content: (His pupils contracting sharply) Sacrifice? What are they doing with Nian'er?

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing his churning emotions. The Tianji Record flickered again. This time, he changed his angle, carefully tracing from the edge of that residual aura. The text on the fragment gradually became clear:

「Three thousand zhang beneath the imperial mausoleum in the northwest of the imperial city, the natural dragon vein confluence point. The formation requires three years; now over two years have passed. On the day of the dragon raising its head, when the Heavenly Fate lock-key activates, the dragon vein power will pour out—at that time, heaven and earth will change color.」

Heavenly Fate lock-key.

That was the reason given when Chen Nian was taken from the Holy Sect.

dialogue.content: (The residual soul of the Tianji Record whispers) Lad, your sister has been chosen. This is her destiny, and also the chess game they have set up.

text.content:
Chen's nails dug deeply into his palms, blood seeping out, yet he felt nothing. Three years of time, he thought his sister was suffering in the Holy Sect, but he didn't know she had already been transferred to the depths of the imperial city's dragon vein.

That little girl who once followed behind him, tugging at his clothes and shouting "Brother," was now being used as a sacrifice for some ritual, imprisoned in the lightless underground!

A surge of murderous intent erupted from Chen Ji, yet it was forcibly suppressed by him in the next instant.

choice.prompt: The imperial envoy was awaiting his response, and Chen Nian's figure was about to vanish from view. Chen Ji had to make a choice—

choices.description: Temporarily appease the imperial envoy, take the opportunity to approach the imperial city forbidden grounds, and secretly investigate the specific location of his sister and the ritual details.
choices.visible_cost: Need to pay more in terms of disguise costs
choices.visible_reward: Gain legal access to the imperial city
choices.risk_hint: The imperial court may have secret agents; any carelessness could expose one's intentions

text.content:
Chen Ji raised his head, his face showing appropriate fear and being overwhelmed by gratitude. He bowed respectfully, his voice slightly trembling: "I am deeply honored by the imperial court's favor. I... I am willing to serve with all my strength."

The acting was impeccable. The imperial envoy nodded in satisfaction, unaware that this "useless person" was burning with such fury inside.

choices.description: Refuse cooperation with the imperial court, strike out directly in the name of protecting his sister, and directly pursue Chen Nian's whereabouts.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the imperial court as a potential ally
choices.visible_reward: Maintain freedom of action, not be controlled by others
choices.risk_hint: May disturb the snake and alert the masterminds behind the scenes

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly shook his head, his voice exceptionally calm: "I thank the imperial court for your favor, but I am used to a leisurely life and cannot bear constraints."

The imperial envoy's smile froze on his face, a dangerous glint flashing in his eyes. Chen Ji paid no attention, turning and walking away—he wanted to find another way.

choices.description: Make no clear statement, use various excuses to prevaricate, and strive for more time to think of countermeasures and gather intelligence.
choices.visible_cost: May arouse the imperial court's suspicion
choices.visible_reward: Gain buffer time, can secretly contact other allies
choices.risk_hint: The imperial envoy is no ordinary person; stalling too long may incur suspicion

text.content:
Chen's face showed a troubled expression, stammering: "This matter... this matter is too significant. Please allow me to discuss it with my sect's elders before making a decision."

The imperial envoy furrowed his brow, clearly dissatisfied with this answer, but didn't dare cause a scene on the spot. He only said coldly: "Give me an answer within three days."

The crowd gradually dispersed. Chen Ji stood alone, his gaze following that bright yellow canopy as it faded into the distance. His fists clenched until they rattled, his knuckles white from the force.

Three years ago, he personally sent Chen Nian into the Holy Sect, thinking that was the best way to protect her. Three years later, she had become the most important piece in the chess game jointly set up by the imperial court and Holy Sect.

And he, this person who prided himself on having no strategy unaccounted for, had actually been kept in the dark all along!

Night deepened. Chen Ji returned to his lodging, closed the doors and windows, and lit a solitary lamp. He took out the Tianji Record fragment from his chest, his fingertips gently brushing over those obscure characters. Mr. Mo's residual soul appeared, watching him silently.

"Lad, do you want to save your sister?"

Chen Ji lifted his head, his eyes filled with interweaving fury and grief: "You have a way?"

"A way... there is. But the price may be more than you can bear." Mr. Mo's voice was ethereal yet heavy, "The dragon vein ritual is no small matter. If you forcibly intervene, you will not only expose yourself but may also trigger the Tianji Record's fatal backlash."

dialogue.content: (His voice hoarse, yet carrying unwavering resolve) I can bear it. Tell me, whatever the price.

text.content:
Mr. Mo was silent for a long while before finally sighing: "The day of the dragon raising its head is just three months away. Before then, you must accomplish three things—first, decipher the weakness of the dragon vein formation; second, obtain a pass that can get you close to your sister; third, awaken her from the seal before the ritual begins."

Each task was a life-or-death endeavor.

But there was not the slightest retreat in Chen Ji's eyes; instead, a certain kind of desperate light was kindling.

「There is one more thing.」 Mr. Mo's residual soul suddenly flickered, 「Your sister's existence itself interferes with the Tianji Record's foresight. Wherever she is, everything becomes blurred. This means——」

Chen Ji interjected: 「It means she herself is the key to breaking the situation."

「Correct.」 Mr. Mo's voice carried a hint of satisfaction, 「You're finally starting to understand. The Tianji Record chose you, perhaps precisely because of her existence.」

Chen Ji lowered his eyelids, and Chen Nian's childhood appearance surfaced in his mind. Back then, she was always following behind him, stumbling and calling out "Brother." Later, when the family suffered disaster, the two were forced to part. He had sworn he would find her.

Now, she was waiting for him to rescue her from the depths of the imperial city.

But... what about his feigned death arrangement? How would his grand chess game of the world continue?

An unprecedented contradiction surged in his heart. This was the first time since he began orchestrating the world that he felt so powerless.

choice.prompt: Clues about his sister are now clear, but the difficulties facing Chen Ji are only just beginning—

choices.description: Temporarily suspend all plans, invest all energy into the operation to rescue Chen Nian. Even if the chess game is disrupted and cards are exposed, so be it.
choices.visible_cost: Years of arrangement may go to waste
choices.visible_reward: Chances of reunion with sister greatly increase
choices.risk_hint: Completely expose one's whereabouts, may invite encirclement and suppression from multiple forces

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes, then opened them again. The struggle in his gaze had vanished, replaced by a kind of近乎偏执的坚定.

「The chess game can be rearranged, the world can be contested again.」 His voice was soft, yet carried undeniable resolve, 「But Nian'er is one of a kind.」

choices.description: While rescuing his sister, do not abandon the original layout. Let Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and others assist in the rescue, while he continues to manipulate the chess game in the shadows.
choices.visible_cost: Need to divide energy; may not succeed at either
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the overall situation while having hope of rescuing sister
choices.risk_hint: Allies may be put in danger; risk of sacrifice increases

text.content:
Chen Ji opened his eyes, and his gaze recovered its usual depth and calmness. He began rapid calculations—Su Qingyao had influence in the Inner Sect, Ye Qing's demonic path mist could conceal auras. If he could draw both into the situation...

「A good game is never played with a single piece.」 He murmured to himself, 「This move, I want it all.」

A soft sound suddenly came from outside the window. Chen Ji's expression changed slightly, his palm already pressing on the short sword at his waist.

「It's me.」 A cold voice came from outside the window.

Chen Ji relaxed slightly but remained vigilant: 「Senior Fellow Su, what brings you here so late at night?」

Su Qingyao's figure appeared at the window. Moonlight outlined her cold and sharp features: 「What did you see during the day? Your reaction... was not right.」

dialogue.content: (Her gaze sharp) Chen Ji, you think I can't see it? That waste would never show such an expression during the day.

text.content:
Chen Ji and Su Qingyao faced each other. His heart警报大作 in his chest. This woman had gotten dangerously close to the truth for the third time.

Under the moonlight, their shadows intertwined. Su Qingyao's eyes were full of probing, while Chen Ji was rapidly weighing options—continue to hide, or reveal part of the truth?

Just as the atmosphere reached a critical tension, a blood-red pillar of light suddenly erupted from the direction of the imperial city in the distance, piercing directly into the clouds!

「That is——」 Su Qingyao's face changed dramatically.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, and a foreboding premonition surged in his heart: The dragon vein ritual... started early?

From within the blood-red pillar came a tragic scream, that voice... unmistakably Chen Nian's!

Chen Ji's reason completely collapsed at this moment. He shoved open the window, his form turning into a shadow rushing toward the imperial city. Su Qingyao called out behind him, but he couldn't hear a thing.
